🚀 𝗥𝗲𝗮𝗹-𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗙𝗿𝗮𝘂𝗱 𝗗𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗞𝗮𝗳𝗸𝗮, 𝗦𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗸, 𝗙𝗮𝘀𝘁𝗔𝗣𝗜 & 𝗙𝗹𝗮𝘀𝗸
Fraud detection is critical in financial transactions, and real-time processing is key to preventing losses. To tackle this, I built a Real-Time Fraud Detection System using Kafka, Spark, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Flask to analyze fraudulent transactions as they happen.

📌 𝗔𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 & 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗰𝗸
🔹 Kafka – Streams real-time transactions
🔹 Spark (Databricks) – Processes & detects fraud patterns
🔹 FastAPI + PostgreSQL (AWS RDS) – Backend API & database
🔹 Flask + Chart.js – Fraud analytics dashboard

📌 𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗜𝘁 𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝘀?
1️⃣ Kafka ingests live transactions
2️⃣ Spark Streaming applies fraud detection logic
3️⃣ FastAPI Backend stores fraud alerts in PostgreSQL (AWS RDS)
4️⃣ Flask UI visualizes fraud patterns using charts & tables

📌 𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗙𝗲𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲𝘀
✅ Real-time fraud detection with event-driven architecture
✅ Top-N fraud locations visualization (Bar Chart)
✅ Paginated fraud transaction table
✅ Scalable cloud-based infrastructure

📌 𝗖𝗼𝗱𝗲
💻 GitHub Repo: https://lnkd.in/gNjrg3we

📌 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗻𝗴𝗲𝘀 & 𝗡𝗲𝘅𝘁 𝗦𝘁𝗲𝗽𝘀
🔹 Optimizing Spark for low-latency processing
🔹 Managing Kafka consumer offsets for fault tolerance
🔹 Deploying with AWS Lambda & API Gateway

💡 How do you approach real-time fraud detection? Let’s discuss! 🚀

#DataEngineering #FraudDetection #Kafka #Spark #AWS #FastAPI #StreamingData #MachineLearning #CyberSecurity #SoftwareEngineering

ai_analysis.summary: The post describes a high-level real-time fraud detection system for financial transactions. Kafka ingests live transactions, Spark Streaming applies fraud-detection logic, FastAPI stores fraud alerts in PostgreSQL on AWS RDS, and Flask presents fraud patterns through Chart.js charts and tables. The system uses an event-driven architecture and includes features for top-N fraud-location visualization and paginated fraud transactions. Future work includes optimizing Spark for lower latency, managing Kafka consumer offsets for fault tolerance, and deploying through AWS Lambda and API Gateway. The post does not provide fraud rules, implementation code, performance figures, or deployed architecture details.

interview_questions.question: What is the end-to-end data flow in the described real-time fraud detection system?
interview_questions.answer: Kafka ingests live transactions, Spark Streaming applies fraud-detection logic, FastAPI stores resulting alerts in PostgreSQL on AWS RDS, and Flask displays the information through charts and tables.

interview_questions.question: What role does each major component play in the fraud detection pipeline?
interview_questions.answer: Kafka streams transactions, Spark processes them and detects fraud patterns, FastAPI provides the backend, PostgreSQL stores alerts, and Flask with Chart.js provides fraud visualization.

interview_questions.question: Which reliability, latency, and deployment improvements are identified for the system?
interview_questions.answer: Optimizing Spark for low-latency processing is identified as a future step.
